description: Metered Streets Pittsburgh Parking Authority is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Pittsburgh. Its tags are _etl, harvested, pittsburgh, pittsburgh parking metered streets, transportation. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, ZIP. The portal shows 2024-06-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
